programme.desc: Members of the Fallen Angels Murder Club search for answers about the mysterious death of one of their own. Hollis finds himself at the center of the investigation when a journalist covering the case also turns up dead.

programme.title: Fallen Angels Club: Heroes and Villains
programme.desc: Members of the Fallen Angels Murder Club search for answers about the mysterious death of one of their own. Hollis finds himself at the center of the investigation when a journalist covering the case also turns up dead.

programme.title: Too Close
programme.desc: A story of passion, sex, love and abandonment that involves two couples. Everything gets complicated when the man from the first couple meets the woman from the second.

programme.title: Murder in...
programme.desc: MURDER IN BERRY. The body of Antoine Noiret, eminent professor of oncology, is found in Mare au Diable. Ritual signs found around the lake suggest that the victim was sacrificed during a Sabbath, a witchcraft ceremony.

programme.title: Murder in...
programme.desc: MURDER AT MULHOUSE. While investigating a crime committed in an old potash mine near Mulhouse, Lieutenant Sandra Bauer becomes suspicious of the lawyer who deprived her of custody of her son during their divorce.

programme.title: Fantasy Island
programme.sub-title: Mj Akuda & The 1St, 2Nd, And 3Rd Wives Club
programme.desc: “FANTASY ISLAND” is set at a luxury island resort, where literally any fantasy requested by guests can be fulfilled.

programme.title: Outlander
programme.desc: Jamie's authority is tested when an old rival from Ardsmuir shows up to take up residence on the Ridge. Claire finds a new way to deal with the trauma of her assault by Lionel Brown.

programme.title: The Forbidden Fruit
programme.desc: Halit remains secretive about recovering his fortune and continues to work alongside Sahika to exact his revenge. Furthermore, Zehra loses control again, giving in to alcohol again, and Yildiz begins to get dangerously close to Kerim.

programme.title: The Forbidden Fruit
programme.desc: Halit continues to fake his fall, while preparing his next move against Sahika. On the other hand, Ender receives an unexpected proposal within the company, and Yildiz begins to feel increasingly confused about Kerim.

programme.title: Quarto 309
programme.desc: Songül follows Nergis as he prepares to meet Samet, but he does everything to avoid running into Songül. Kurtulus plans a surprise to try to compensate Nilüfer. Will Nilüfer forgive Kurtulus?

programme.title: Quarto 309
programme.desc: Afraid of Songül's reaction, Nilüfer and Nergis arrange a secret meeting with Kurtulus and Samet. Onur finds a way to get rid of Dr. Onur. Will Lale accept Onur's gift? Nilüfer and Nergis get ready to go to Kurtulus and Samet.

programme.title: Quarto 309
programme.desc: Songül and her daughters are excited about their new business project. Seeing Kurtulus and Onur together, Samet cannot understand the situation. Once you find out the truth, you lose all hope. Filiz discovers the cause of so much nausea.

programme.title: The Wedding Veil Legacy
programme.desc: Tracy meets Nick again and he helps her save the original draft of a well-known poem, in exchange for her helping him run his restaurant. But Tracy begins to feel uncomfortable as the two grow closer...

programme.title: A Taste of Death: A Mystery by Hannah Swensen
programme.desc: No one is more surprised than Hannah Swensen when her mother, Delores, finds the lifeless body of a homeowner—a regular customer at The Cookie Jar—while searching for a home for her sister Michelle.

programme.title: Random Romance
programme.desc: Lieutenant Callie Jackson returns home from a military mission and discovers that her late grandfather's restaurant is struggling.

programme.title: Fallen Angels Club: Murder Mysteries
programme.desc: Ex-convict and aspiring lawyer Hollis Morgan becomes the target of police investigation when a member of her book club is found murdered.

programme.title: Exchanged before birth
programme.desc: Couple Olivia and Brian's lives are turned upside down when they discover that one of their two babies, conceived through in vitro fertilization, is not the biological twin of the other, having been implanted into Olivia by mistake.

programme.title: War of the Sexes
programme.desc: The real story of the tennis game in 1973, which pitted world No. 1 Billie Jean King and former champion Bobby Riggs face-to-face on the court - in a true war of the sexes.

programme.title: Eduardo Scissorhands
programme.desc: Eduardo is the inventor's greatest creation. However, the creator's sudden death leaves Eduardo alone, incomplete and equipped with sharp scissors instead of hands. But then Eduardo meets Kim, who takes him to live with her and her family.

programme.title: How to Kill Your Husband
programme.desc: Nancy Crampton-Brophy, known for writing about homicides and tumultuous relationships, fantasies about killing or running away from her husband, and even faking her own death, was arrested in 2022 for murdering her husband.

programme.title: Meeting in Manhattan
programme.desc: Marisa is a struggling single mother working at a luxury hotel, who dreams of a better life for herself and her son. But everything changes when a hotel customer and Senate candidate mistakes her for a rich woman from high society...

programme.title: The work
programme.desc: After witnessing a Lebanese mafia boss murder an undercover police officer, 16-year-old Miki enters the witness protection program. Suspecting an internal leak, the director of the LKA assigns custody to Sarah Brandt, a first-time agent. Along with an incompetent team, Sarah must hide Miki and her divorced parents in an isolated Italian estate. However, when internal tensions flare and a nighttime attack exposes them to danger, Sarah realizes that they have been betrayed and that the only way to survive is to play by their own rules.

programme.title: 10 minutes less
programme.desc: Frank is a criminal who, together with his companions, tries to rob a bank. However, the police end up being alerted and while trying to flee, a mysterious assailant hits Frank on the head, causing him to lose part of his memory. Rex, the leader of the gang, awaits answers about the failed robbery, while Frank will try to do everything possible to recover the 10 minutes that have disappeared from his memory and find the person responsible for his fall from grace.

programme.title: Bloodshot
programme.desc: Upon returning from a mission in Mombasa, elite soldier Ray Garrison and his wife are kidnapped and murdered. Shortly after, Ray awakens in the Spirit Reborn Project facility with no memory of his past.

programme.title: The mask of Zorro
programme.desc: 1821. The Mexican army strives to liberate its country from the Spanish yoke. In the Californias area, the evil Spanish governor, Don Rafael Montero, is about to lose everything. In a last attempt to catch his nemesis, the masked swordsman "Zorro", Montoro prepares to murder three innocents. With the help of two orphans, Joaquín and Alejandro Murrieta, Zorro frees the prisoners. Then he will give both boys a special medallion and flee on his horse, Tornado, after marking Montero with a small "Z" on his neck as a warning. But that same night the soldiers enter the house of a nobleman named Don Diego de la Vega and arrest him since they are convinced that he is the real Zorro. Don Diego's wife dies, he is locked up in prison and his daughter, Elena, is taken to Spain as Montoro's daughter, where he will raise her as if she were his own. Twenty years later, Montoro secretly returns to California and looks for Diego in prison but cannot find him because he is unrecognizable due to age. However, the prisoner does remember the man and with a thirst for revenge like he had never had before, he escapes from prison and decides to put an end to his enemy forever. Along the way he will discover Elena, his daughter, who is as beautiful as her mother when she was murdered. Tired, old and completely destroyed by the years of captivity, Don Diego de la Vega will decide to train an adult Alejandro Muerrieta, now a bandit and rogue, to become the new Zorro and avenge all the suffering that the evil Rafael Montero caused him. At first Anthony Hopkins rejected the role of Don Diego de la Vega because he had unbearable pain in his back. When a laser operation managed to alleviate the problem, he then offered to accept playing the wise old "Zorro."

programme.title: The legend of Zorro
programme.desc: 1850. California has been tortured by the colonizers for years but will finally become the thirty-first state of the Union. Zorro suspects that a group of individuals intend to sabotage this decision for their own benefit, so he will stop them in a heroic feat. At the same time, McGivens, a French baron, is dedicated to blackmailing the inhabitants of California to keep their lands and leaving those who earned their living from the countryside in absolute poverty. Don Alejandro de la Vega, the one nicknamed "Zorro" with his mask, his sword, his horse and his cape, has finally been able to marry the beautiful Elena and has a ten-year-old son named Joaquín. The little boy misses his father, whom he hardly sees, and on the other hand idealizes the figure of his hero, Zorro, without knowing what his true identity is. Alejandro promises to leave the mask behind forever and dedicate himself to his family, but when a new crisis appears in California, he acts once again to solve it. Elena, feeling cheated, kicks her husband out of the house and presents him with divorce papers. At that moment, an old companion of the woman arrives at the scene: the French aristocrat Army. When he finds out about Elena's separation, he immediately begins to court her while attending to his affairs in the secret brotherhood in which he is involved. Now Alejandro will have to choose between alleviating the suffering of the oppressed or returning to his family. But to do so he must defeat the always shady Baron Army. For "The Legend of Zorro" both Steven Spielberg and Robert Rodriguez planned to direct the film, but in the end they did not take the job, although Spielberg did stay on as executive producer.

programme.title: Absolute power
programme.desc: Luther, a specialist in grand thefts, plans to rob the mansion of a tycoon who is on vacation in the Caribbean. However, the victim's wife appears unexpectedly.

programme.title: The President and Miss Wade
programme.desc: Andrew Shepherd (Michael Douglas), president of the United States and widower for just over a year, begins a romance with Sydney Wade (Annette Benning), a consultant for an important environmental organization. This relationship, in the middle of the election campaign, will be taken advantage of by Bob Rumson (Richard Dreyfuss), the opposing candidate, to attack the president.

programme.title: Together and mixed up
programme.desc: Jim and Lauren have a disastrous blind date and decide not to see each other again. Together with their respective children, the unique couple separately books an idyllic vacation at a luxurious resort dedicated to safaris in Africa. Without knowing they were going to meet, Lauren and Jim end up spending more time together than they imagined.

programme.title: This house is a ruin
programme.desc: Anna (Shelley Long) is a young and attractive violinist who stays for a few days with her boyfriend, the lawyer Walter Fielding (Tom Hanks), in the luxurious apartment of her ex-husband, the great conductor Max Beissart (Alexander Godunov). They are happy, but they want to be even more so. Walter's formula is very simple, happiness is in a little house on the outskirts of New York with its white fence, a dog, two children and a little woman. But, at least for the moment, Anna's intentions do not involve marriage. However, the urgent need to look for a house is imposed when her ex-husband returns suddenly and needs to reoccupy her apartment. Walter turns to his friend Jack (Josh Mostel), a real estate agent, who provides him with a real bargain a few kilometers from New York, a dream house for very little money. After managing to raise the money, the couple buys the house from Estelle, its quirky owner (Maureen Stapleton). But unfortunately, mishaps begin to happen in this fabulous mansion: doorbells burn, the bed sinks, the door falls, steps break, ceilings fall apart, pipes shake and, as the final number, the staircase shatters. But since they still really like the house, with the best of their will they set out to fix the mess. They turn to the service of the unique Shirk brothers, Art (Joe Mantegna), the carpenter, and Brad (Carmine Caridi), the plumber.

programme.title: hidden figures
programme.desc: As a child, African-American Katherine proved to be a mathematical prodigy. Now, as an adult, she works for NASA... but in the USA of 1961, as a woman and black, her brilliant work means very little.

programme.title: Ghostbusters
programme.desc: Manhattan, New York. After almost thirty years without hearing from them, the ghosts and demons have once again escaped from the underworld to destroy the city. This time a new team of Ghostbusters, made up of a group of four women, is ready to put an end to any spectral threat.

programme.title: Asterix and Obelix against Caesar
programme.desc: The small village of Asterix and Obelix is ​​the last place that is not under the control of Rome. When the tax collector doesn't get money from its inhabitants, Julius Caesar goes to see what's so special about them.

programme.title: Asterix and Obelix: Mission Cleopatra
programme.desc: The action takes place in the year LII BC. Although not all of Gaul is yet occupied, Egypt, ruled by the powerful Cleopatra, has fallen under the yoke of the Roman Empire. Fed up with Caesar's sarcasm, the proud and beautiful queen makes a bet with him: if he manages to build a palace in the space of three months, he will recognize that the Egyptian people are the greatest of all. Cleopatra entrusts such an impossible mission to Numerobis, an emerging avant-garde architect who undertakes a journey to Gaul to ask for help from Asterix and Obelix.

programme.title: Siege status
programme.desc: Third collaboration between director Edward Zwick and Denzel Washington after "Glory Times (1989)" where he won his first Oscar for Best Supporting Actor and "In Honor of the Truth" (1996) and magnificent hand in hand full of tension between Denzel Washington and Bruce Willis. New York City becomes the target of a wave of terrorist attacks. FBI agent Anthony Hubbard (Denzel Washington) is appointed head of the joint anti-terrorist force and together with CIA agent Elise Kraft (Annette Bening), with important contacts in the Arab-American community, they will be in charge of arresting those responsible. Meanwhile, the government declares martial law and sends General William Deveraux (Bruce Willis) to command the troops in charge of occupying the city.

programme.title: Llamaradas
programme.desc: He was a child when he witnessed the death of his father in an act of service during a fire. Twenty years later, Brian is also a firefighter in Chicago. He is in a difficult trial period led by his brother Stephen who is very demanding of him. Both brothers will try to overcome disputes and memories of the past while an arsonist sets fires in the city.

programme.title: Adoptive parents
programme.desc: Coline and André are in perfect harmony with their daughter, Garance, and their son-in-law Harold. But Garance separates from Harold and orders his parents to never see him again, the in-laws cannot do it. They will have to lead a double life to continue seeing their beloved son-in-law.

programme.title: A town called Dante's Peak
programme.desc: Harry Dalton (Pierce Brosnan) is one of the most renowned volcanologists at the United States Geological Survey. Four years after his partner's death during a volcanic eruption in Colombia, Harry receives a call from his boss, Paul Dyfrus (Charles Hallahan), to discuss the unusual behavior of a hitherto dormant volcano. Meanwhile, the city of Dante's Peak, located on one of the volcano's plains, is celebrating being named the second most desirable place to live in the country. Harry begins his investigation in the area and discovers clear signs that the volcano could soon erupt. The scientist wants to put the city on alert, but the inhabitants have economic interests that could be harmed if they heed Harry's warnings. Everyone ignores it until it's too late. The director, Roger Donaldson, was drawn to the project because he was once a geology student. Many of the film's special effects were done practically. The ash from the volcano was actually very fine shavings of newspaper. According to an interview with Donaldson, the camera that Harry Dalton uses during his investigation is actually owned by Pierce Brosnan. Initially the main role was going to be played by Michael Douglas. Most of the film's exteriors were shot in Wallas, Idaho. It was also filmed on Dante's Peak, adding certain details with digital technology.

programme.title: 10 minutes less
programme.desc: Frank is a criminal who, together with his companions, tries to rob a bank. However, the police end up being alerted and while trying to flee, a mysterious assailant hits Frank on the head, causing him to lose part of his memory. Rex, the leader of the gang, awaits answers about the failed robbery, while Frank will try to do everything possible to recover the 10 minutes that have disappeared from his memory and find the person responsible for his fall from grace.

programme.title: Bloodshot
programme.desc: Upon returning from a mission in Mombasa, elite soldier Ray Garrison and his wife are kidnapped and murdered. Shortly after, Ray awakens in the Spirit Reborn Project facility with no memory of his past.

programme.title: The silence of the lambs
programme.desc: Promising FBI agent Clarice Starling is pulled from her special forces training by Jack Crawford of the FBI's Behavioral Study Unit. He wants me to study a notorious and eccentric psychopath named Habbibal Lecter, who was a forensic psychiatrist imprisoned for multiple murders and cannibalism. The purpose of the meetings between Clarice and Hannibal must be for the latter to agree to help her catch a serial killer named Buffalo Bill. But what the woman did not imagine was that Hannibal would turn out to be a sophisticated and cultured man restricted from others by glass walls. Although he is polite at first, he soon begins to lose patience when Clarice tries to create a psychological profile for him. While the hunts continue throughout Chicago and Buffalo Bill collects his kills without the FBI being able to do anything to solve it, Clarice will have to find a way to ingratiate herself with a man who ate the people around him and show him that, in addition to being intelligent, she is not afraid of him at all. Things will start to get difficult when the Senator's daughter disappears and everything indicates that Buffalo Bill has her and that soon her body will appear as a new victim. The events of this film take place after what happened in the film Hunter (1986). Although there are many characters in common in the two films, only two of the actors share films. Frankie Faison plays Lt. Fisk in Hunter and Barney in The Silence of the Lambs; On the other hand, Dan Butler plays the fingerprint expert FBI agent in Hunter and an entomologist in "The Silence of the Lambs."

programme.title: Shark
programme.desc: Summer vacation has arrived in the small resort town of Amity Island. While the city council is in charge of making the place a wonderful and entertaining place for tourists, a great threat is approaching, endangering the safety of bathers. The police chief, Martin Brody (Roy Scheider), receives a tip about the disappearance of a young woman on one of the beaches. When they search the terrain, the young woman's dismembered body is found buried in the sand. The coroner's first resolution is that the girl was the victim of a shark attack. The police chief prepares to close access to the beaches but is intercepted by the Mayor. Brody argues with him until the coroner intervenes again and assures that his first conclusion was incorrect, and that the girl died in a terrible accident when she got caught in the propeller of some boat or ship. The police officer resigns and accepts the Mayor's "recommendation." A horde of tourists arrives on Amity Island that same day. While on Chief Brody's watch, a boy is killed by the shark and the truth becomes impossible to hide. A shark hunting specialist named Quin (Robert Shaw) offers his services in exchange for being the only one to receive the entire reward. Anyway, seeing the ferocity of the attacks, Brody asks for help from a marine biologist, Matt Hooper (Richard Dreyfuss), who identifies the shark attack as that of a white shark, one of the most dangerous. Quin, Brody and Hooper will try to hunt the feared animal together before someone else is hurt. The film's soundtrack is composed by John Williams, a highly successful composer who also created the soundtracks for the most renowned films by Steve Spielberg and George Lucas. Among them are those of "Schindler's List" and "Star Wars", in addition to the main theme of the "Harry Potter" saga. The film is based on a novel by writer Peter Benchley.

programme.title: The big shark (Jaws 3)
programme.desc: Third sequel born as a result of Spielberg's famous film "Jaws". When a baby white shark ends up trapped in a water park, the owner decides to use it as a lure to attract more customers. What is not expected is that the mother, an adult shark measuring more than 35 feet, will go looking for him and begins to kill bathers indiscriminately. Mike Brody, the adult son of Police Captain Brody, who killed a killer shark ten years ago, will try to take down the terrifying beast.

programme.title: Shark, revenge
programme.desc: Years pass and Ellen Brody continues to live in Amyty. Her sons, Sean and Micahel, no longer work at Sea World and her husband passed away some time ago due to cardiac arrest. Currently, Sean is the city's police officer. On Christmas night, he receives the order to go to the beach to unscrew a log from a buoy. In the process he is eaten by a great white shark. Convinced that the sharks have some kind of vendetta against her family, Ellen travels with Michael, his wife and daughter to a house they have in the Bahamas. What Ellen and her family don't know is that the threat has followed them there. The film's main tagline, 'This time it's personal', was parodied in 'Back to the Future II'. In the film you can see a poster for the fictional 'Jaws 19', directed by Max Spielberg and whose slogan is 'This time it's very personal.' This phrase has ended up becoming a cliché in movies with many sequels. Actor Michael Caine could not attend the Oscars and collect his award for 'Hannah and Her Sisters', because he was filming this film at that time. The water in the tank in which the film's climax was shot was filled with blue dye, so Micahel Caine and Lorraine Gary ended up with their hair completely dyed this color. Lorraine Gary was nominated for Best Actress at the United States Academy Awards for Science Fiction, Fantasy and Horror.

programme.title: Van Helsing
programme.desc: 19th century. Human beings are stalked by terrifying monsters that have survived throughout the centuries, generation after generation. The mythical monster hunter Van Helsing is tasked with defeating the seductive, mysterious and powerful Count Dracula. To do this he must travel to the enigmatic and dark Transylvania.

programme.title: The seventh son
programme.desc: Centuries ago, Master Gregory captured the evil and powerful witch Malkin. But the witch managed to escape and prepares her revenge. Meanwhile, Master Gregory sets out to teach his young apprentice Tom Ward to fight black magic in record time.

programme.title: The source of life
programme.desc: An odyssey about a man's fight to save the woman he loves in three time spaces: the 21st century, the conquest of America, and the future.

programme.title: Cross-fire
programme.desc: After witnessing the brutal murder of a store owner and his son, firefighter Jeremy Coleman miraculously escapes with his life. Having witnessed the murders and being forced to testify against the gang of gangsters that carried them out, specifically against their leader, David Hagan, he is integrated into the witness protection program under the supervision of the Marshalls. Agent Talia will be in charge of protecting Jeremy's life from this cruel murderer. Inspector Mike Calla will be in charge of handling Coleman's case, a man who precisely lost his wife at the hands of the same gangster who committed this crime, and who since then has not stopped searching for him to do justice. The problem comes when Jeremy Coleman's new identity is compromised, so the firefighter is forced to take action to recover his life and save those of his loved ones.

programme.title: While the city sleeps
programme.desc: Two police officers find themselves at opposite ends of their careers as they find themselves caught up in a fateful night in Los Angeles. A rookie trying to escape his father's shadow sees his first patrol turn into a disaster as he tries to find a missing girl and hunt down two murderers who have committed several crimes throughout the night. Meanwhile, his partner, a burned-out police officer, explains to him how the job works.

programme.title: The Kaiser's Last Kiss
programme.desc: A German officer is sent to Holland to determine whether the British Secret Service has infiltrated the home of Kaiser Wilhelm II during the start of World War II, but begins a dangerous and lethal romance with a young Dutch Jew with consequences neither of them could have foreseen.

programme.title: hidden figures
programme.desc: As a child, African-American Katherine proved to be a mathematical prodigy. Now, as an adult, she works for NASA... but in the USA of 1961, as a woman and black, her brilliant work means very little.

programme.title: Ghostbusters
programme.desc: Manhattan, New York. After almost thirty years without hearing from them, the ghosts and demons have once again escaped from the underworld to destroy the city. This time a new team of Ghostbusters, made up of a group of four women, is ready to put an end to any spectral threat.

programme.title: the ghostbusters
programme.desc: Dr. Peter Venkman (Bill Murray) takes advantage of his research scholarship at the University to torture boys and conquer girls who take psychosensory tests. He is actually a very capable scientist who resorts to logic rather than superstition, but he uses the girls' gullibility to flirt with them. His friends, Dr. Raymond Stantz (Dan Aykroyd) and Dr. Egon Spengler (Harold Ramis), carry out ectoplasmic studies to investigate the possible existence of ghosts and even capture one for later study. The first time they have a warning about the real presence of a ghost in a library, they don't know how to deal with it and run away. It is after they are kicked out of the University that they decide to mortgage Stantz's house and start their own ghost hunting company. Over time they manage to develop machines that trap ectoplasmic beings for later study. But the jobs that come to the office are nonsense with what is about to fall on them. A young woman who lives alone begins to have truly shocking paranormal experiences in her home and decides to call the Ghostbusters to help her. The investigation will take them further than they ever thought they would go, seeing things they would never have dreamed of seeing. In Aykroyd's original script, the story took place in a future where there would be teams of ghostbusters like there are today of paramedics or firefighters. But the budget studied for that type of film amounted to three hundred million dollars and Aykroyd was forced to adapt it to the scientific reality of the eighties. Initially other actors were going to play some of the most important roles in the film: John Candy was going to be Louis Tully, John Belushi was going to be Dr. Peter Venkman, and the role of Winston was written specifically for Eddie Murphy.

programme.title: Ghostbusters II
programme.desc: The Ghostbusters discover that New York is once again headed toward supernatural disaster, with a river of ectoplasmic matter running beneath the city and an old sorcerer attempting to take possession of a baby. to be born again.

programme.title: back to the future
programme.desc: Marty McFly is a teenager tired of his family. One day he receives a call from his friend Doc, a scientist whom everyone thinks is crazy, to show him his latest invention. It is a time machine that consists of a car powered by plutonium. Marty accidentally activates the machine, traveling back in time to 1955. In the past, Marty discovers his teenage parents and mistakenly avoids their first date. Marty must reunite his parents, convince Doc that he comes from the future and manage to travel back to the present. Initially, the role of Marty McFly was going to be played by Eric Stoltz. However, in the middle of filming, the directors fired Stoltz when they considered that he was not the right actor. Michael J. Fox, who had been an early choice, was committed to the show Family Ties at the time. However, after Stoltz's dismissal he was available to record the film and immediately accepted the role. Christopher Lloyd plays Doc. Lloyd initially turned down the role, but eventually accepted it once he read the script. The film's director, Robert Zemeckis, along with the screenwriter, Bob Gale, had already been interested in the idea of ​​making a film about time travel. The final idea came about after Gale reflected on the possibility of having become friends with his father if they had attended the same school. After Back to the Future, Robert Zemeckis directed other successful films such as Forrest Gump, Cast Away and Flight. The success of Back to the Future led to the production of a trilogy, as well as the creation of an animated series.

programme.title: Back to the future II
programme.desc: Marty, his girlfriend Jennifer and Doc travel to the future, to the year 2015, to prevent the couple's son from being imprisoned for a problem with the law. However, the presence of the temporary travelers will cause a bigger problem than the one they intended to fix and things will become increasingly complicated. The problem begins when Marty buys a sports almanac with all the results of the competitions up to the year 2000, in order to make easy money when he returns to the past. As in the first part, Marty McFly and Doc are played by Michael J. Fox and Christopher Lloyd, respectively. However, two of the actors from the first part, Crispin Glover and Claudia Wells, did not participate in the second part. Crispin Glover, who played Marty's father in the first part, was replaced by Jeffrey Weissman, who used facial prosthetics to look as much like Glover as possible. For her part, Elisabeth Shue was in charge of replacing Claudia Wells, who in the first part played Jennifer, Marty's girlfriend. Although the first film was not intended to have a sequel, the box office success motivated Robert Zemeckis to film two more films. After two years spent building the sets and writing the script, filming began in February 1989. Without a doubt, the biggest challenge was creating the futuristic vision of Hill Valley. It should be noted that this second part and the third part of the trilogy were filmed simultaneously.

programme.title: Back to the future III
programme.desc: Stranded in 1955, Marty receives a letter from his friend Doc telling him that he is in 1885 and that the time machine is broken and cannot be repaired. Doc isn't worried about being stuck in the past, saying he's happy working as a blacksmith. However, Marty discovers an old grave in which he reads that Doc died in 1885, and decides to go rescue his friend. Using the time machine Doc had hidden in 1955, Marty travels to the Wild West, where he discovers that his friend has run afoul of a gang of bullies and fallen in love with a teacher. Using technology from the time, Marty and Doc must find a way to return to the future. Since the second and third parts of the trilogy were filmed simultaneously, there are no significant changes in the cast with respect to Back to the Future II, with MartyMcFly and Doc once again played by Michael J. Fox and Christopher Lloyd, respectively. The most notable addition compared to the previous installments is that of Mary Steenburgen, playing Clara Clayton, the teacher with whom Doc falls in love in 1885. The idea of ​​traveling back in time to 1885 arose during the filming of the first film, when Robert Zemeckis asked J. Fox what historical period he would like to visit. Fox answered that it was the Wild West, and Zemeckis and Bob Gale decided to use this idea for the third part. Although the first film was not intended to have a sequel, the box office success motivated Robert Zemeckis to film two more films. After two years dedicated to building the sets and writing the script, filming of the second and third parts (they were filmed simultaneously) began in February 1989. Some scenes were filmed in Monument Valley. The train scenes were filmed at the Railtown 1987 State Historic Park, a historic train line located in Jamestown.

programme.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
programme.desc: Peter Parker was abandoned by his parents when he was still a child, and was raised by his Uncle Ben and Aunt May. Somewhat marginalized at school, Peter wants to know his past and find out who he is, but there he meets his first love, Gwen Stacy. When Peter discovers a briefcase that belonged to his father, he begins a quest to learn how his parents disappeared, something that will take him to Oscorp and the laboratory of his father's former partner, Dr. Connor, where he is bitten by an experimentally modified spider that gives him incredible powers. The murder of his uncle by a thief will make him seek revenge, catching the criminals he finds in his path, so he realizes that his destiny is to help people. But Dr. Connor, in turn, is forced to test his own experiment (a lizard serum that regenerates body limbs) on himself after his dismissal, which turns him into The Lizard. This will spread panic among the citizens, and Peter will be forced to use his powers. It is the first film of a cinematographic reboot of this character, since due to script problems Sony had canceled the fourth installment of Spider-Man, opting for this reboot. Marc Webb is in charge of directing the film, and he specializes in the world of music videos, in which groups such as Green Day, My Chemical Romance, Evanescence, Maroon 5 and Fergie have featured him. His only films are (500) Days Together and the first and second installment of this new Spider-Man saga. Andrew Garfield plays Peter Parker. He began in theater and acted in Leones por Corderos and the television film Boy A, which gave him recognition; just like his performance in The Social Network. Emma Stone plays Gwen Stacy, and participated in films such as Campus Bunny, Ghosts of My Ex-Girlfriends, Crazy, Stupid, Love or Entitled to Friction. His role in Easy A earned him a Golden Globe nomination.

Things get complicated when the villain Electro appears with a thirst for revenge. However, it won't be the only thing Peter has to face, as the return of an old friend, Harry Osborn, brings new clues about his past.

programme.title: World's Ultimate Adventures
programme.desc: Chef and content creator Julie Lin is on a Turkish adventure - combining her passion for food with history. Travelling through the south east, known as the gastronomic heart, she first stops in the city of Gazianetep - world famous for its baklava. Julie uncovers what makes this delicacy and the locally grown pistachios inside it so special. Heading further east, she visits the Neolithic site of Karahan Tepe, a discovery so significant that it is reshaping our understanding of human history. Guided by the archaeological team, Julie explores their latest finds, including what may be the world's oldest kitchen. Her journey ends in Şanlıurfa, cooking with a family keeping traditional recipes alive, discovering the city's signature smoked pepper, and finishing her trip with a vibrant cultural, night-time celebration and an unusual raw-meat dish.

programme.title: Inside China's EV Revolution
programme.desc: At a time of heightened geopolitical conflict and uncertainty, soaring fuel costs are driving up demand for electric vehicles around the world. Chinese EV's are leading the way. In the span of a decade, China's electric vehicles sector has gone from fledgling industry to automotive powerhouse, challenging some the world's top automakers on their home ground. We examine how China transformed into the world's leading manufacturer of green energy cars, from innovations in battery technology to the concept of a smartphone on wheels, and ultimately what lies ahead for the future of transportation.

programme.title: The Media Show
programme.desc: For years, YouTube was largely seen as the home of creators who built their audiences online. But increasingly it's becoming a destination for established TV presenters too. James May, best known for Top Gear and The Grand Tour, joins Katie Razzall alongside producer Lucy Brown to discuss building their YouTube channel, Planet Gin. Holly Graham, chief commercial officer at Little Dot Studios, explains what it takes to build a successful YouTube brand and whether television success translates online. The Times's chief sports reporter Martyn Ziegler revealed that FIFA president Gianni Infantino had been exploring plans to sell stakes in the World Cup to private investors. Martyn explains how he broke the story, while Tariq Panja, global sports correspondent at The New York Times, discusses the growing role of investigative journalism in football. The resignation of University of Cambridge professor Jason Arday has become one of the biggest stories in British academia. Jack Grove, investigations editor at Times Higher Education, explains how he first uncovered concerns about Arday and why legal threats prevented publication at the time.

programme.title: Force Of Nature
programme.desc: Documentary series revealing the incredible ways in which all life is impacted by our journey around the Sun. Our coasts have always been an extreme environment to raise a family, but the challenges of parenthood are exacerbated with warming seas - forming earlier than ever before, a hurricane catches a flamingo colony while their chicks are still on the nest. Rain, wind and rising sea levels are a triple threat, but these extraordinary birds have begun to adapt to the new extremes by extending their breeding window and given those who lost their chicks a second chance - meanwhile, a sea otter mum faces a huge winter storm in California and a clownfish on the Great Barrier Reef witnesses her anemone home bleach. However, the clownfish is not ready to give up and sets about reviving it - perhaps most remarkable of all, though, is a little anole lizard that clings on for dear life during a hurricane, surviving as those with the longest toes are the species most able to keep their grip.

In our second case, Jane Lewis was taken into foster care when she was 11 days old - it was hoped that Jane's mother would one day return to look after Jane, but she never did and Jane remained in care for the whole of her childhood. Jane recently discovered that her mother had three other children - brothers of which two who were in care and one who was adopted - and now she wants to find them.

Tom cooks a feast to say thank you: a mouth-watering pork loin steak with chestnuts and wild mushrooms. High in the dramatic Dolomites, Tom visits a desmontegada - a festival to mark the changing of the seasons - where he learns about the powerful impact the fresh mountains have on the local cuisine, including the local pasta. With the mountains as inspiration, he cooks up creamy cheese, sage and pancetta pasta.

programme.title: Car History
programme.sub-title: Mercedes racing: the beginning of an era
programme.desc: Power, passion, pole position – Mercedes has been writing motorsport history for 120 years. The list of successes of the brand with the star is long. As early as 1894, a Daimler and a Benz took part in the first car race. The victories at the French Grand Prix in 1908 and 1914 are outstanding. Car History shows how Mercedes dominated racing from the first automobile race onwards. (Station info).

programme.title: Super Cars
programme.desc: With the Macan Turbo, Porsche sets the benchmark in terms of driving dynamics in the SUV segment. The optional performance package increases output from 400 to 440 hp. A major competitor comes from Maserati. With the Levante, the Italians want to shake up the highly competitive sporty SUV market. (Station info).

programme.title: Australian Drag Racing Championship 2024
programme.desc: The "Australian Drag Racing Championship" is a regional motorsport series for top petrol dragsters that reach speeds of around 500 km/h in under 5 seconds (channel info).

programme.title: Crash

programme.title: Dumbest Stuff on Wheels
programme.desc: Bizarre mishaps, weird crashes and unbelievable nonsense on four wheels, fabricated in everyday life and immortalized on camera. Great workout for your laughing muscles! (Station info).

programme.title: Isle of Man Tourist Trophy 2026
programme.desc: The highlight of every TT, the Senior TT. Hicky is considered the favorite, but 6 rounds have to be completed first. Can Harrison crack it this time or will Michael Dunlop rise from the ashes like Phoenix after 2 Supersport wins this week? Questions about questions – they are answered here. (Station info).

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: They make history, back then on the racing track, today at auctions for collector's cars. Bolides like the Ford GT 40, Jaguar D-Type or Mercedes 300 SL. Back then they were developed for one purpose: winning. Today, what was once developed into investments and objects of speculation worth millions. But even today there are fans who hit the slopes with these cult classics; on the hunt for new records and new victories. (Station info).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.desc: In Toffen, Switzerland, Top Speed ​​presenter Martin Utberg gives viewers a behind-the-scenes look at an online classic car auction and highlights some of the special classics featured in the gallery. In Singen, southern Germany, Emmanuel Bacquet passionately talks about the special vehicles from the Karosas collection. And at the end of the show it's exciting in Toffen, where bidders do everything they can to get their favorite classic. (Station info).

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Stuntman Dominik is an expert in falls and body stunts. But today he has to drive the stunt car. The task: drive straight through a truck and do a complete rollover. Firstly: The number is not for the faint of heart. Second: The number is dangerous! (Station info).

programme.title: Biker Lifestyle
programme.desc: The north of Thailand is a popular travel destination, not just for adventurous individual tourists. The north is known for its mountainous, densely forested areas and therefore this region is also a paradise for motorcyclists. Thousands of curves on well-developed roads with little traffic and a diversity of culture and landscape make this region a perfect holiday destination for us to escape the winter in Germany for the fourth time. We will take you on a 1600 km long motorcycle tour to the most beautiful places in northern Thailand. (Station info).

programme.title: On Tour
programme.desc: The Steinbeisser Trophy is a must for every off-road fan. Machine against nature – that is the motto of the trophy. A bit of madness is part of it when the drivers perform breakneck maneuvers with their 800 HP monsters. Moderator Benedikt Weber doesn't just look behind the scenes - he bites the hard stone and rides the toughest off-road trophy himself. (Station info).

programme.title: Classic
programme.desc: The Mille Miglia in Italy: In 2002, the legendary 1,000-mile race celebrated its 75th anniversary and 372 vehicles built between 1927 and 1957 took part. The route took the participants from Brescia via the capital Rome back to Brescia. On the total of 37 special stages it was important to adhere to the specified times exactly. Also: Classic at the Dixi meeting. (Station info).

programme.title: Green wave
programme.desc: They are one of the most popular cars on the market: compact SUVs. Numerous manufacturers are now converting this segment to electric. Hyundai surprises with the Ionic 5. Mercedes-Benz relies on the new EQA. Opel is using electrification for a new brand face with the Mokka E. And Volvo offers over 400 hp in the XC40 Recharge. (Station info).

programme.title: Made in....
programme.desc: The Fiat 500X, SUV offshoot of the popular 500, is built in Melfi in southern Italy. The factory is one of the most modern in Europe. The FCA Group has invested almost one billion euros in the expansion. Up to 1,600 vehicles roll off the production line here every day. Made in Italy – FIAT provides insight into the production of the oldest and largest Italian automobile manufacturer. (Station info).

programme.title: Four-wheel drive adventure
programme.desc: Adventure Allrad, a special interest magazine about off-road and all-wheel drive vehicles. The focus is on off-road veterans and cars with four-wheel drive. Today in Adventure All-Wheel Drive: Bavarian versus Brit! Can the BMW X3 outperform the Land Rover Freelander off-road? (Station info).

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Practical, comfortable and highway-tested. These German everyday heroes bring home the shopping or are a hell of a lot of fun. At the Lausitzring we let the two most powerful VW Golfs compete against each other: GTI Clubsport versus R. Who does the job better? And the new VW Passat will be more comfortable and efficient. Will it get Volkswagen back on track? (Station info).

programme.title: 4x4 – Das Allrad Magazin
programme.sub-title: VW all-wheel drive on snow and ice
programme.desc: We're doing the ultimate winter test in the Arctic Circle! Three of the latest Volkswagen all-wheel drive vehicles, the Golf R, Tiguan and ID.4 GTX, compete against each other on snow and ice in Sweden. Which VW delivers the most driving fun, the best control and the wildest drifts? From classic combustion engines to electric precision, we show how each model masters the icy curves. (Station info).

programme.title: Tuning – it doesn’t get any lower than that!
programme.desc: Porsche is religion! The beliefs: Punk, Tech and Race. Porsche punk, collector and refiner Magnus Walker gives the movement his face. He preaches individualism for historic vehicles. Tech has been embodied by Alois RUF since 1983. The RUF RT 35 based on Porsche Turbo brings 70 hp more to the road as an expression of the technology movement. And for the racers among the Porsche faithful, the Zuffenhausen religious guardians have the ultimate track tool ready: GT3 RS is the watchword for finally being admitted into the motorsport paradise. (Station info).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.desc: Moderator Martin Utberg is completely unprepared at the food rally, where, in addition to driving a route in a vintage car, there are many side activities on the program. (Station info).

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: In part 2 of the 120 years of Mercedes Motorsport, Car History tells the story of Mercedes in motorsport with many original recordings and original interviews, from the comeback after the accident in Le Mans, the beginnings of rallying in the sixties, the legendary appearance with the red pig in Spa, the countless DTM successes, the return to Le Mans with the prototypes to the Formula 1 World Championships with Mika Häkkinen and the triumph with your own team in Formula 1. (Station info).

programme.title: Super Cars
programme.desc: Supercars with the V8 engine. Its strengths: pulling power even at low speeds, enormous power and a sound that leaves no one cold. For the first time, a V8 from Mercedes-AMG is used in the Aston Martin DB11. The tuner MTM also shows its interpretation of the Bentley Continental V8 S. The result: almost 800 hp and a soundscape that is second to none. (Station info).

programme.sub-title: Ontario Honda Dealers Indy Toronto, Streets of Toronto, Ontario

programme.title: NZ Jetsprint Championship 2025
programme.desc: The New Zealand Jetsprint Championship is the most important sprint boat competition from New Zealand, the country where the sport was founded in 1981. Jetsprinting is comparable to rally sports, but there is only one boat on the track at any given time and boats drive at very high speeds. The up to 500 HP strong jet sprint boats therefore try to achieve the best time on the tracks. (Senderinfo).

programme.desc: It is the icon of sports coupes and convertibles, no other car conveys the attitude to life of the 1960s as much as the Ford Mustang. Also: The Orwell Supersports Cup visits Spa Francorchamps and thoroughbred racing driver Hans Hermann in a portrait. (Station info).

programme.title: Green wave
programme.desc: These electric cars are moving chillout lounges. The Kia EV6 offers high quality standards, a lot of range and 800 volt fast charging technology. Can it catapult itself to the top of the electric middle class? When it comes to charging technology, not even the Mercedes EQE can keep up. The EQE 350 is said to have a range of over 600 kilometers. Is it the insider tip compared to the more expensive EQS? (Station info).

programme.title: Four-wheel drive adventure

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.sub-title: Top Speed ​​Stories with Christian Geistdörfer and Gaby Mair
programme.desc: In the series Top Speed ​​Stories, presenter Martin Utberg welcomes two prominent guests from the world of classic cars in his hometown of Seefeld in Tyrol. Over the course of 24 hours, viewers get to know the guests in a way other than just the success stories of their careers, collections or classic car events. In this episode, former rally world champion Christian Geistdörfer and vintage car collector Gaby Mair are guests at the Casual Luxus Hotel Nidum in Seefeld in Tyrol. (Station info).

programme.title: Super Cars
programme.desc: Who doesn't long for this after a long winter: enjoy the wind in your hair with the top down and let the sound of the engine massage your back. Spring is convertible time. In the 570S Spider. (Station info).

The format combines thrilling motorsport action with in-depth analysis and provides a comprehensive overview of important racing series around the globe. In addition to spectacular scenes on the track, the format offers exciting background reports, technical insights and stories about drivers, teams and their challenges. This creates a diverse look at speed, competition and the passion that drives motorsport worldwide. (Station info).

Will it get Volkswagen back on track? (Station info).

Classic car dealer Michael Schnabl, founder of Motorlegenden, makes car dreams come true. His specialty: rare and incredibly expensive Porsche models. (Station info).

Here, professionals and celebrities engage in a snow battle that is second to none. (Station info).
